name: ec-cross-border
description: Ecuador cross-border tax for 2026: what happens in income tax and in the currency outflow tax (Impuesto a la Salida de Divisas, ISD) when money, income or people cross the border. Covers Ecuadorian-source income of non-residents (LRTI art. 8), the permanent establishment test (RLRTI art. 9), withholding on payments abroad at the 25% company rate and 37% to tax havens, lower-tax jurisdictions and preferential regimes (LRTI art. 39; Res. NAC-DGERCGC26-00000009), interest, reinsurance and payments abroad that are not withheld (LRTI arts. 13, 32), dividends to non-residents at 10% (12% or 14% in the listed cases), shows by non-residents, the tax-haven test, treaty relief and the residence certificate, the foreign tax credit, and ISD at 5% (Ley Reformatoria para la Equidad Tributaria arts. 155 to 162) with its 2026 differentiated rates for imports, exemptions, presumptions and credit. Trigger on: pagos al exterior, retención no residentes, impuesto a la salida de divisas, ISD 5%, paraíso fi
